tracks.title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
tracks.summary: Build, ship and run software reliably: from the shell to SLOs and blameless postmortems.
tracks.capstone: Take a small service from a laptop to production: CI that fails fast, infrastructure as code, a canary deploy, RED dashboards, a 99.9% SLO with its error budget, and a blameless postmortem from a game day.

tracks.title: Software Engineer
tracks.summary: From the notional machine to architecture decisions, testing and working with coding agents.
tracks.capstone: Design, test and ship a small web service with an ADR for each major decision, a test suite that catches a seeded bug, and one feature delegated to a coding agent and independently verified.

tracks.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
tracks.summary: Firmware that meets hardware: registers, timing, interrupts, buses and power.
tracks.capstone: Build a battery-powered sensor node: a debounced button, ADC sampling with filtering, PWM output, an I²C sensor, sleep between readings, and a measured battery-life estimate.

tracks.title: Electrical Engineer
tracks.summary: Circuits, signals and control, on the physics and mathematics they rest on.
tracks.capstone: Design an analogue front end for a sensor: an op-amp gain stage, an anti-aliasing filter chosen from the sample rate, and a PID loop that holds a setpoint, each verified against a hand calculation.

tracks.title: Mechanical Engineer
tracks.summary: Forces into structures, structures into machines that can be made.
tracks.capstone: Design a load-bearing bracket: choose the material by performance index, size it by hand, validate with FEA and a mesh-convergence study, check fatigue and resonance, and tolerance it for manufacture.

tracks.title: Physicist / Research Scientist
tracks.summary: The physics spine with the mathematics to read and derive it.
tracks.capstone: Design and run a measurement (e.g. g from a pendulum at large amplitude), model it from first principles, propagate the uncertainty, and explain the residuals.

tracks.title: Chemist / Chemical Engineer
tracks.summary: Bonding, energetics and equilibrium, through to mechanisms and analysis.
tracks.capstone: Plan a synthesis or process step: balance it, predict yield from equilibrium and kinetics, size the heat removal, and confirm the product with spectroscopy data.

tracks.title: Life Scientist / Biomedical
tracks.summary: Molecules to ecosystems, with the chemistry and statistics a lab biologist needs.
tracks.capstone: Design an experiment (e.g. an enzyme-inhibitor assay or a CRISPR knockout), state the hypothesis, the controls and the statistical test before collecting data, and interpret the result without confusing correlation and cause.

tracks.title: AI Agent Engineer
tracks.summary: Teach agents and prove they learned: specs, evals, skills, independent grading.
tracks.capstone: Teach a subagent a new domain with the DULTA agent-learner protocol: baseline cold-start, notes revised over moves, `leak` clean, an independent grader, normalized gain reported, and the notes installed as a skill.

tracks.title: Educator / Learning Designer
tracks.summary: Design instruction that measurably works, for people and for agents.
tracks.capstone: Design one week of a course with DULTA's Directed Teaching mode: aligned outcomes, activities and assessments (`dulta.py align` clean), a pre/post test with normalized gain, and a panel round on the materials.
